# AIDM® — Austin Institute of Dental Medicine: current offers

> aidm.dental publishes the current promotional offers and prices of the Austin Institute of Dental Medicine (AIDM®), a teaching dental practice at 1401 Philomena Street, Suite 200, Austin, TX 78723 (Mueller). Open 7am–7pm, Monday to Saturday. Phone (737) 434-2436. Main website: https://aidm.org — standard (non-promotional) fees are at https://aidm.org/pricing/.

Promotional prices apply only to qualifying patients, usually with payment in full, and cannot be combined with insurance, financing, membership discounts or other promotions. Final fees are confirmed after a clinical evaluation. Treatment may be provided by dental residents under the supervision of licensed clinical faculty.

## Offers (English)

- [Exam + X-rays](https://aidm.dental/new-patient): $100. Includes: Comprehensive dental examination; Dental X-rays as needed; Cavity-risk assessment and oral-hygiene guidance; Personalized treatment plan reviewed with you.
- [Emergency Dental Care](https://aidm.dental/emergency): Same Day Appointments. Includes: Same-day appointments, subject to availability; Every specialty under one roof; Problem-focused emergency evaluation; X-rays as needed to diagnose; Dedicated dental surgery rooms for urgent extractions.
- [Comprehensive Braces Treatment](https://aidm.dental/braces): $2,950 (First 100 patients). Includes: Comprehensive braces treatment; Routine orthodontic adjustment visits; Appliance removal; Standard orthodontic retention; Care coordinated throughout treatment.
- [Invisalign® Clear Aligners](https://aidm.dental/invisalign): $3,900. Includes: Personalized clear-aligner treatment; Standard aligner laboratory materials; Routine orthodontic visits; Treatment completion and appliance removal; Standard orthodontic retention.
- [Early Orthodontic Treatment](https://aidm.dental/early-orthodontics): $2,500. Includes: Limited early orthodontic treatment; Routine treatment visits; Growth-appropriate treatment planning; Retention when included in the treatment plan; Care based on the child’s stage of development.
- [Single Implant + Crown](https://aidm.dental/dental-implant): from $3,750 (Range $3,750–$5,000). Includes: Clinically appropriate 3D imaging; Digitally planned surgical implant guide; Dental implant placement; Final ceramic crown; Bone grafting when in the selected pathway.
- [Full-Arch Fixed Teeth (All-on-X)](https://aidm.dental/full-arch): from $18,000 (Per arch · moderate $22,000 · complex $26,000). Includes: Comprehensive diagnostic work-up; Four to six conventional dental implants; Multi-unit abutments; Interim complete and fixed teeth; Final fixed full-arch restoration.
- [Implant-Supported Dentures](https://aidm.dental/snap-in-dentures): from $9,500 (Per arch · moderate $12,500 · complex $17,000). Includes: Comprehensive evaluation and planning; Clinically appropriate imaging; Two or four implants based on the tier; Implant attachments; Interim and final removable dentures.
- [Root Canal Treatment](https://aidm.dental/root-canal): from $995 (With ceramic crown $2,300 · $2,400 · $2,500). Includes: Limited-field 3D imaging; Initial root canal treatment; Protective core buildup (crown bundle); Porcelain or ceramic crown (crown bundle); Coordinated endodontic and restorative care.

## Ofertas (español)

- [Especial para Pacientes Nuevos](https://aidm.dental/es/paciente-nuevo): $100. Incluye: Examen dental completo; Radiografías dentales según sea necesario; Evaluación del riesgo de caries e higiene oral; Plan de tratamiento personalizado.
- [Atención Dental de Emergencia](https://aidm.dental/es/emergencia): Atención hoy. Incluye: Atención el mismo día; Abierto de lunes a sábado, 7 a.m. a 7 p.m.; Evaluación enfocada en el problema; Radiografías necesarias para el diagnóstico; Salas de cirugía dental en las instalaciones.
